main.summary: Envelope that records the serializer kind, serializer version, and library version used to produce the payload.

item.description: [HeaderSize..end] : Serialized object payload produced by the serializer identified in the header

field.name: ByteSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of a single byte-valued field in the envelope header.

field.name: Magic
field.summary: The magic byte sequence used to identify enveloped payloads. The ASCII bytes for "KD".

field.name: MagicOffset
field.summary: Offset of the magic bytes in the header.

field.name: MagicSize
field.summary: Size of the magic byte sequence.

field.name: FormatVersionOffset
field.summary: Offset of the format version byte in the header.

field.name: FormatVersionSize
field.summary: Size of the format version field.

field.name: SerializerKindOffset
field.summary: Offset of the serializer kind byte in the header.

field.name: SerializerKindSize
field.summary: Size of the serializer kind field.

field.name: SerializerVersionLengthOffset
field.summary: Offset of the serializer version length byte in the header.

field.name: SerializerVersionLengthSize
field.summary: Size of the serializer version length field.

field.name: SerializerVersionOffset
field.summary: Offset of the serializer version payload in the header.

field.name: LibraryVersionLengthSize
field.summary: Size of the library version length field.

method.name: Unwrap
method.summary: Return the payload region of an enveloped byte array as a ReadOnlyMemory without copying. If the input does not have an envelope, the entire input is returned.
method.param: The enveloped or legacy byte array.
method.returns: The raw serialized payload without the envelope header.

method.name: UnwrapMemory
method.summary: Return the payload region of an enveloped memory block as a ReadOnlyMemory without copying. If the input does not have an envelope, the entire input is returned.
method.param: The enveloped or legacy memory block.
method.returns: The raw serialized payload without the envelope header.

method.name: HasEnvelope
method.summary: Determine whether a byte array begins with the envelope magic bytes.
method.returns: True if the input starts with the envelope magic bytes.

method.name: ParseHeader
method.summary: Parse all header fields from an enveloped byte array and return a ParsedSerializationHeader.
method.returns: The parsed header, or null if the input is not enveloped.

method.name: GetSerializerVersionLength
method.summary: Get the stored serializer version length from an enveloped byte array.

method.name: GetSerializerVersionOffset
method.summary: Get the offset of the serializer version payload within the header.

method.name: GetLibraryVersionLengthOffset
method.summary: Get the offset of the library version length byte within an enveloped byte array.

method.name: GetLibraryVersionLength
method.summary: Get the stored library version length from an enveloped byte array.

method.name: GetLibraryVersionOffset
method.summary: Get the offset of the library version payload within an enveloped byte array.

method.name: GetPayloadOffset
method.summary: Get the offset where the serialized payload begins within an enveloped byte array.

method.name: ComputeHeaderSize
method.summary: Compute the total header size in bytes for a given serialization identity.
method.param: The serialization identity containing version byte arrays.
method.returns: The total header size in bytes.

method.name: BuildHeader
method.summary: Build the immutable header bytes from a serialization identity containing the serializer kind, serializer version, and library version.
method.param: The serialization identity to encode into the header.
